record.question: Who is second from the right?
record.explanation: Using the restored shared statement, the unique left-to-right order is B, A, C, E, D. Counting from the right gives D first and E second, so E is second from the right. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed paper and worked derivation checked on 26 October 2026.
